# Retained Component Dictionaries

The `.cif` files are pinned wwPDB Chemical Component Dictionary records used
to check bundled graphs, atom inventories, ideal coordinates and formal charges.
They are dictionary inputs, not deposited structures or geometry-recovery references.
Do not replace them merely to make an output expectation pass.

`ACE` retains the complete isolated acetaldehyde graph; its linked cap inventory
is a context-qualified application. `SAN` and `CMP` retain the standalone
sulfanilamide and cyclic AMP dictionaries. `SO4` supplies the selected sulfate
graph and charge control.
